beats.title: pictures over music in the cafeteria

beats.cap: *they both notice Tikal and Knuckles on separate tables keep looking and turning back to each other*

beats.text: *sigh* Poor Knucklehead
and Tikal
and maybe you should go talk to them
Pssh, I know you don't wanna go to Knuckles when he's pissed, neither do I
Oh you want me to go talk to Knuckles? You should've said so
Haha, you're really funny
*smirk* You go talk to Tikal.. I'll go talk to Knuckles
Okay good luck
*grabs her hand* Please come with me
Sonic, if he lays a hand on you then he'll get hammered. Don't worry
Yeah... you're right *lets go of her hand*
*walking towards Knuckles* ( Just be gentle.. if he decides to be a d**k then he knows what he's gonna get )
Hey... Knuckles! *sits by him*
Hmph, what do you want?
I was just wondering if you're taking Tikal to prom
*grabs him* WHAT'S IT TO DO WITH YOU?!
because I heard you both had a argument, now put me down cause I'm here to help
SO SHE TOLD YOU? EH? WHAT ELSE DID SHE TELL YOU?!
Nothing else, now put me down or you're gonna have to mess with my tough cookie *points at Amy*
Fine *lets go of Sonic* So what do you mean you're gonna help me?
Well I can tell you miss Tikal, and you want to be back together with her
Who do you think you are? Trying to get into my business!
*sigh* Fine, if you can handle this yourself, I'll leave you be *about to walk away*
Wait!
Hmm? *turns back to Knuckles*
*sigh* I do need your help
At least you admitted it
Don't push it hedgehog
but here's the first tip, you need to control your temper. Girls hate seeing boys with anger problems
What you talking about? I can control my temper
Then why is Tikal upset over you?
...because I can't control my temper *sigh*
Exactly, she's fed up of you getting grumpy all the time
Alright I get it, so what else do you want me to do?
Ask her to prom!
WHAT?!
